tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refuted the stationary avalanche model well beyond tolerance. With no informative confirmation details to identify another stationary smooth mechanism, abstain rather than submit an unsupported replacement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The tested model has train RMSE 2.70879 and fresh-confirmation RMSE 1.745924, far above tolerance; no confirmation data identify a specific replacement law.
This targets trajectory/memory ODE identifiability, but the observed failure is a sharp gradient-dependent drop at fixed horizon, not evidence for a hidden time trajectory.
The existing targeted readings already show the threshold-region decline and sign crossing. More of the same does not resolve why the fitted mechanism fails fresh confirmation.
